name: vids-studio-mcp
description: A local, Google Vids-only MCP bridge to an explicitly attached Chrome tab

scripts.test:backend: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'backend_*.py' && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/backend.test.mjs
